title: excoecaria sylvatica
intro: Excoecaria sylvatica, commonly known as the Poison Tree, is a species of plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Excoecaria sylvatica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, that exhibit anti-proliferative, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective activities. However, the exact bioactive constituents and their therapeutic effects are not yet fully understood and require further research.
